text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, after Sakura Chiyono O has a number of victories under her belt…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O and I are riding a train to the hot spring vacation we won at the shopping district's raffle.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: We'll have to transfer trains in seven stations.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Let me know if you want to take a nap. I'll stay awake for us.
choice_data_list: Let me know if you need a nap, too.
Let me know if you need a nap, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Nooo can do.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Today, it's my turn to take care of you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I even prepared a schedule for us, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day before we set off, she gave me a small pamphlet titled Hot Spring Vacation Schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Emblazoned in huge letters on the first page is "A Giant Thank-You Gift for My Amazing Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wow, this place looks so luxurious! It must be pretty renowned.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And now, please open to page five of your schedule.
choice_data_list: Let's see… "This resort boasts famous Umamusume among its clientele."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! That's right! I did some research in advance…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But it seems neither of our rooms have karaoke machines in them…
choice_data_list: You seem so disappointed.
You seem so disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I mean, it would've been fun to get rowdy and belt out a few songs after relaxing in the hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But since we can't do that, I practiced some magic tricks instead! Hehe. I'll show you them in our free time!
choice_data_list: You really prepared for this!
You really prepared for this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I did! Now then, why don't you head into the hot springs first?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Sakura Chiyono O pushing me forward, we head into the building. I can already tell she's going to be a good host during this trip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure accepting her hospitality will be the thing that'll make her happiest, so I decide to do just that.
choice_data_list: Okay, I'll go first.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Please do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so I head for the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After finishing my bath, I wait for Sakura Chiyono O and read the magazine she gave me beforehand in case I got out before her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems to have considered every possibility for today. However, I came here for a different reason.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This hot spring vacation is also a reward for all of her hard work.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! You're already out!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Hm? What's that in your hand?
choice_data_list: Some fruit milk for you.
Some fruit milk for you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Really? Th-thank you for thinking of me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But wait! You didn't have to do that. Today's my day to take care of you!
choice_data_list: I want today to be a reward for you too, though.
I want today to be a reward for you too, though.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! N-no, that's okay…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You're the one who's always looking after me, and it's not like I've really done anything that deserves to be rewarded…
choice_data_list: You've won a lot of races.
You've won a lot of races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: O-oh… Heh. Yeah… Well…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Those victories were all thanks to you, so… If anything, I should be the one who's grateful.
choice_data_list: You've been working so hard, though.
You've been working so hard, though.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I told you that was thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: After all, you were the one who taught me how to work so hard.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Ehehe. Anyway, what's gotten into you? You're making me blush!
choice_data_list: I'm proud to be your trainer.
I'm proud to be your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wha…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Um.
choice_data_list: Thank you, Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehe… Ehehe…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you too, Trainer. For everything.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, gosh! I don't know what to do with myself…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Please don't look at me anymore… It's making me feel embarrassed…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Siiigh… I wasn't expecting to get praised today… It's completely thrown me off…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I messed up the magic tricks I prepared, and now we're just lazing around. I hardly even realized when I finished eating my dinner…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Urgh…
choice_data_list: What matters is that we're having a good time, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you're way too nonchalant about this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah! Nooo! Don't look at me yet. You're going to make me remember our conversation from earlier!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Argh… Sigh… Anyway, um… Like I said, thank you for everything!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After saying that, she covers her face with her hands and rolls around on the tatami mats in embarrassment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense that Sakura Chiyono O and I have formed an irreplaceable bond during this time together.
